import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { issueComments } from "../../../backend/schema/issue_comments";

export const issueCommentsCms = customizeTable<typeof issueComments>("issue_comments", {
    icon: "MessageCircle",
    display: {
        title: "body"
    },
    fields: {
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    }
});
